description: Approvals, Cases, and Notifications modules - Approval queue with one-click approve/reject, case management for failure investigations, and the notification system with actionable items. These are related workflow modules that drive user actions.
steps: Create src/lib/mock-data/approvals.ts: 15+ mock approval records covering types: document_release, work_verification, bom_change. Various statuses (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED). Include requester, approver, linked entities
Create src/lib/mock-data/cases.ts: 10+ mock cases for failure investigations, discrepancies, vendor issues. Various statuses and severities. Include case numbers (CASE-2026-001 format)

Create src/server/routers/approvals.ts: Approvals tRPC router: list (filterable by status/type/approver), getById, approve (with decision notes), reject (with reason), escalate. Protected with supervisor+ role
Create src/server/routers/cases.ts: Cases tRPC router: list, getById, create, update, close, assign. Protected with engineer+ role

Create src/server/routers/notifications.ts: Notifications tRPC router: list (paginated, filtered by read status), markRead, markAllRead, dismiss, getUnreadCount. Generates mock notifications from approval/case/document events
Create src/lib/validators/approvals.ts: Zod schemas for approval actions (approve/reject with notes, escalate with reason)
Create src/lib/validators/cases.ts: Zod schemas for case CRUD (case_number auto-generated, title, description, severity required)

Create src/app/(protected)/approvals/page.tsx: Approvals page. PageFrame with PageHeader ('Pending Approvals' with count badge). Quick filter tabs: All, Document Release, Work Verification, BOM Change. Data table: Title, Type (badge), Requester, Urgency, Due Date, Actions (Approve/Reject buttons inline). Approve/Reject opens confirmation dialog with notes field. One-click approve for non-critical items

Create src/components/approvals/approval-card.tsx: Card view for a single approval item. Shows: title, type badge, requester info, linked entity preview, urgency indicator, due date, approve/reject buttons. Expandable to show more context

Create src/components/approvals/approval-dialog.tsx: Confirmation dialog for approve/reject. Shows summary of what's being approved, textarea for decision notes, confirm button (primary for approve, destructive for reject)

Create src/app/(protected)/cases/page.tsx: Cases page. PageFrame with PageHeader ('Cases', 'New Case' action). Data table: Case#, Title, Type (badge), Status (StatusBadge), Severity (color-coded badge: LOW=green, MEDIUM=amber, HIGH=orange, CRITICAL=red), Assignee, PL Number, Created, Actions. Filters: status, severity, type, assignee. Full table controls

Create src/components/cases/case-form.tsx: Case creation/edit form. Fields: title, description (rich text area), type (select), severity (select with color preview), PL number (optional, 8-digit), vendor_name (optional), tender_number (optional), assignee (user select). Uses React Hook Form + Zod

Create src/app/(protected)/notifications/page.tsx: Full notifications page. Grouped by: Today, This Week, Earlier. Each notification: type icon, title, body, timestamp, action button, read/unread state. Bulk actions: Mark all read. Filter: unread only, by type
Update src/server/routers/_app.ts to include approvals, cases, notifications routers
Update sidebar navigation to include Approvals (with pending count badge) and Cases links
Update notification store to use tRPC data
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes
acceptance_criteria: Approvals page shows pending items with one-click approve/reject
Approve/Reject actions open confirmation dialogs with notes
Cases page shows all cases with severity color-coding
Case creation form validates required fields
Notifications page shows grouped notifications with action buttons
Notification bell in header shows unread count from tRPC
Clicking notification action navigates to relevant entity
Sidebar shows pending approval count badge
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
